proof_body:
by
  intro μ _ a b t
  have h1 : (fun x : ℝ => a * x + b) = (fun x => x + b) ∘ (fun x => a * x) := rfl
  rw [h1, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), MeasureTheory.charFun_map_add_const, MeasureTheory.charFun_map_mul]
  simp [mul_comm]
target_source: ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (a b t : ℝ), MeasureTheory.charFun (μ.map (fun x => a * x + b)) t = Complex.exp ((t * b : ℝ) * Complex.I) * MeasureTheory.charFun μ (a * t)
